title: Door-dispatched workers keep their log tail and carry a harness budget
gloss: door worker log tail + harness budget
description: From yoh findings 127240d6 and b21c18d0 (9iz). A door-dispatched worker's log output after the confirm window goes nowhere, and the door carries no per-worker harness budget (TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT), which the wave path used to set. For an unattended cloud run both matter: the tail is where a failed worker says why, and a budget is the runaway guard (liveness itself is b1t's: pi's session log, not a wall clock).
notes: 2026-09-29 12:22 - Evidence from epic hn6's second cloud run (run_aaf6886d, 2026-09-29): 'ticfac cloud logs <run> --tick r5i' held 5 lines per attempt and stopped at 'checked out <sha>' — the door's spawn drains output only inside confirmDispatch, which returns at the first byte of output, and nothing drains after. r5i try 2 then settled failed ~5 min later with zero model calls and nothing pushed, and its cause is unrecoverable: no log, and its container has since idled out. PR #130 (door reclaims a settled worker's container at its first terminal observation) makes this strictly worse: the unread tail is now destroyed at settle, not just left unread. The fix belongs in the state route: drain the work process's output on every look (offset persisted per job, continuing from the confirm window's offset) and drain to the end BEFORE the reclaim destroy. Stopgap landed separately: a failed settle line now names the worker's exit code and its class (fix/hn6-worker-log).
acceptance_criteria: A door-dispatched worker's whole log reaches the run's logs; the door carries a harness budget taken from config and the worker honours it; tests cover both
